title: The Tsetlin Machine Goes Deep: Logical Learning and Reasoning With Graphs
new_feature: Graph Tsetlin Machine (GraphTM): learns nested deep clauses over hypervector-encoded directed, labelled multigraphs via message passing between nodes, built on the convolutional Coalesced TM; supports sequences, grids, relations and multimodal input.
